exposure: prenatal diagnosis of congenital cystic adenomatoid malformation
cohort: Singleton pregnancies with confirmed isolated fetal congenital cystic adenomatoid malformations
finding: Despite a good survival rate, isolated prenatal diagnosis of congenital cystic adenomatoid malformation is associated with significant perinatal morbidity.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was performed in 76.2% of cases of prenatally diagnosed congenital cystic adenomatoid malformation.
